soundness_flags.label: prop:tree-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed canonical two-group, two-period reduction lies outside the maintained model, whose fixed-horizon assumption requires T>=3; either extend the formal model and recheck the result at T=2 or state only the admissible acyclic T>=3 reduction.

source_verification_receipts.version: EU Tax Observatory Working Paper 31, May 6 2025
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 20-21, Section 3.2.2, equations (3.13)-(3.14), especially lines 606-668 in the PDF text
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper fits individual and time fixed effects on never-treated/not-yet-treated observations, predicts individual counterfactuals, aggregates the observed-to-predicted treated ratio, and recommends a resampled-unit panel bootstrap.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Econometric Methods published article proof, volume 8 issue 1
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 3-8, Section 2.2 and Section 3.1, equations (13)-(15), especially p. 7 discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article establishes the canonical multiplicative ratio-of-ratios setup, explains PPML consistency under a correctly specified exponential mean, and states that PPML need not be the most efficient estimator; it does not give a staggered-panel cycle frontier.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and Section 1, especially lines 40-55 and 940-941 of the journal HTML
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article identifies cohort-time ATTs under nonlinear staggered DiD and states canonical-link equality between imputation and pooled quasi-likelihood estimates; it is not an efficiency frontier for the aggregate PTT ratio.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair the tree sanity result by formally admitting T=2 or replacing it with a fully internal T>=3 acyclic benchmark, then show the estimator and variance formulas reduce algebraically.

Add a theorem-level comparison that derives the aggregation bridge directly from the published Moreau--Kastler score equations and states precisely which departures (weights, covariates, offsets, missingness) break equality.

Extend the frontier to an economically material dependence regime, such as dyadic/shared-country dependence, deriving the altered tangent space and attainable variance rather than substituting clustered standard errors.

recommended_next_step: Revise the out-of-model two-period sanity claim; the corrected fixed-horizon cohort-mean efficiency-frontier kernel is otherwise suitable to advance to Stage 0 at field tier.
